subject: HIPAA / BAA eligibility — next steps & SOC 2
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Procurement <procure@healthcloud.com>, HealthCloud Security <security@healthcloud.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2029 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: HIPAA / BAA eligibility — post-call recap and next steps

Hi Jane / HealthCloud team,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Redwood offerings: Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) and Private (VPC / on-prem) are the recommended deployment modes for PHI workloads.
- BAA: Redwood provides a BAA for Dedicated and Private deployments only. We do not recommend using the shared hosted API for PHI without an approved exception.
- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II in Nov 2028; report available under NDA (attached).
- PHI boundaries: Customer prompts/responses can be configured to avoid retention. For PHI we recommend Dedicated or Private with:
  - customer-managed KMS,
  - logging disabled for prompt/content retention,
  - KV cache controls and eviction policies, and
  - retention and audit log settings per contract.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2028.pdf (requires NDA), BAA_Draft_Redwood.docx, Security_Questionnaire_SIG.xlsx (we can fill).

Proposed next steps:
1) HealthCloud security to confirm the questionnaire scope (SIG vs custom) — we can start filling the SIG.
2) We’ll send the SOC 2 report under NDA and a draft BAA for review.
3) Technical follow-up: loop in Dev (Dev Patel) to confirm KV cache and logging controls for your use case.

Would you like us to start with the SIG worksheet or send the BAA first?

Thanks,
Marissa

Forwarding HealthCloud's questions — can you confirm the technical answers below and prepare a concise doc we can send to them (and fill the SIG worksheet). Highlights they asked for:

- Log retention disabling: can be configured per-customer on Dedicated and Private (we have an option to disable application-level retention; platform control-plane retains operational logs for support/audit and can be redacted under contract).
- KV cache: we can disable KV prefix caching for a customer and set automatic eviction policies; we also support per-customer cache scopes so PHI need not be stored.
- KMS: Dedicated and Private support customer-managed keys (BYOK) in supported regions; Private on-prem supports full customer key control.

Request: Dev, can you draft a one-page technical summary stating recommended configuration for HealthCloud (Dedicated + BYOK + logging disabled + cache disabled) and any limitations (e.g., real-time monitoring/tracing will be limited if logging disabled). Rachel, can you start the SIG worksheet and attach the draft BAA we already have.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Jun 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: HIPAA / BAA eligibility — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks Marissa — quick technical summary below to send to HealthCloud. Happy to jump on a call if they'd like deeper detail.

Technical summary (sendable):
- Eligible deployment modes for PHI: Dedicated (managed, isolated GPU pools) and Private (VPC / on-prem). Shared hosted API is not covered by our standard BAA and is therefore not recommended for PHI.
- BAA availability: We provide a standard BAA for Dedicated and Private customers. The draft BAA is attached; timelines for signature are typically 2-3 weeks after legal review (faster with DocuSign).
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II on 2028-11-30; report is included (requires NDA). No open exceptions of material impact to inference or data handling controls.
- Logging & retention: On Dedicated/Private we can disable content retention and disable per-customer request logging. Platform operational logs (control plane) are retained for support/audit and can be redacted or limited per contract. Note: disabling logging reduces observability; recommend a short retention window for traces for troubleshooting.
- KV cache and model cache: We support per-customer cache scopes and can disable caching of prompts/outputs. If caching is disabled, cold-start token costs may increase; we can tune batching and pre-warming to mitigate.
- KMS & encryption: Customer-managed keys supported (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private. Full HSM/BYOK for on-prem Private.
- Additional controls: IP allowlists, VPC peering, private endpoints, and audit-log exports to customer S3/GCS are supported.

Action items:
- Rachel: populate SIG worksheet and attach the draft BAA and SOC 2.
- Marissa: send the technical summary + attachments to Jane and procurement; propose a 30-minute follow-up to review contract timelines.

Dev Patel
Staff Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
